stories.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define immutable audit log schema strictly aligned to existing debug_logger fields (chat_id, session_id, tool_name, token_usage, error_flag, timestamps) and extend minimally with hash_chain fields; enforce compatibility with current MongoDB document structure without introducing a new audit system.

stories.title: Append-Only Write Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement append-only enforcement as a wrapper around debug_logger such that only insert operations are permitted; add per-session hash chaining for tamper evidence while preserving existing Mongo insert patterns and avoiding any new storage abstraction.

stories.title: Audit Log Read API (Controlled Access)
stories.description: Expose a read-only internal FastAPI endpoint within FindCare backend for audit inspection (dev/admin only), reusing main.py routing and ensuring no external or Brain-level audit access is introduced.

stories.title: System-Wide Audit Logging Integration (FindCare Scope)
stories.description: Instrument FindCare backend components only (tool_router, safety_service, and existing debug_logger call sites) to capture tool execution, safety triggers, and errors with de-identified payloads; explicitly exclude Brain or cross-application audit instrumentation.

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Tamper Detection Validation
stories.description: Extend test_debug_logger.py to validate append-only guarantees, hash chain integrity, and mutation attempt rejection within the FindCare backend context only; simulate tampering and ensure detection without introducing cross-system dependencies.
